summary: The exact H1 change correctly retires shared loading when navigation invalidates the prior route, while a destination lookup can immediately claim loading for its own pending work. Epoch guards continue to prevent stale reads from changing current state. The public-profile success/failure controls remain route-safe and do not lock auth forms.

results.controlled_profile_cases: Four cases: register/login crossed with provider success/failure. Shared loading stayed false; current route and auth form remained stable; submit remained enabled; stale profile result did not replace the current projection.
results.lookup_to_login: Controlled county lookup success and failure both became stale after login navigation. Loading cleared synchronously at navigation and remained false after stale settlement; old lookup did not populate counties or surface an error.
results.directory_to_register_with_lookup: The old directory microtask returned while a current SchoolData.getStates read remained pending. Loading stayed true until the registration lookup completed, then cleared with the expected fixture states.
results.newer_lookup_before_older: A newer California county lookup completed before an older Washington lookup. The older result was ignored and did not overwrite the selected state, county choices, or loading state.

limits: All controller/provider behavior used synthetic volatile fixtures; no real teacher data or backend calls.
Rendered-tree checks only; no browser visual QA or screenshot inspected.
Canonical source build was not run.
